mentions.name: Eima
mentions.description: This app combines a todo list and calendar, letting users schedule their todos by simply dragging them onto the calendar. It specializes in multi-occurrence todos, such as recurring todos or tasks needing multiple attempts, which prior todo-calendar tools did not handle well. Access is available with the code EARLYEIMA.
mentions.problem: Similar todo-calendar apps were largely VC-backed, pivoted to AI, and focused on enterprise users and trends, resulting in unsatisfying todo-focused calendar experiences; multi-occurrence todos like recurring tasks or tasks requiring multiple attempts were not addressed by prior tools.
mentions.audience: Eima focuses on personal use rather than enterprise users, unlike similar prior tools.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Eima (https://eima.app) which combines your Todo List and Calendar, allowing you to schedule your todos by simply dragging them onto the calendar.
